payload.prompt: What does OCR convert into editable, searchable text?

options.rationale: OCR reads text visible in scans, photographs, screenshots, and image-based PDFs. It produces text data that can be edited and searched.
Field extraction assigns recognized values to labels such as Total or Date. It does not convert image pixels into text.
options.better_fit: Use this after OCR when recognized values must be assigned business meaning.

options.rationale: Output ingestion passes existing OCR results to another process. It does not recognize visible text.
options.better_fit: Use this when OCR text and metadata are ready for downstream processing.

options.rationale: Text-region detection and character recognition are individual OCR stages. OCR is the overall process that converts visible text into data.
options.better_fit: Use character recognition after text regions have been found.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. OCR changes visible image text into usable text data.

payload.prompt: True or false?
payload.statement: OCR maps recognized text values directly to labeled business fields.
payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. OCR recognizes visible text; field extraction maps values to fields.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Receipt words could be recognized without being assigned to a date or total field.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: OCR reads visible text, while field extraction gives that text business meaning.

payload.prompt: Complete the technical term.

parts.text: The technology that converts visual text into editable, searchable text is

payload.explanation: OCR is the visual-text conversion stage.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Visible words would not yet become searchable text.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use OCR; field extraction and output ingestion occur after recognition.

payload.prompt: Arrange the OCR stages in order.
payload.explanation: The image enters, is improved, has text areas found, then has characters recognized and output prepared.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A later operation would occur before its needed input existed.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Follow the pipeline from image input through preparation, detection, recognition, and output.

payload.prompt: An expense-claim team has receipt photos and must make their visible words searchable before identifying dates and totals. What should it use first?

options.rationale: OCR converts the receipt's visible words into searchable text data. Dates and totals can then be identified from that text.
Field extraction labels recognized values as dates, totals, or vendors. It needs OCR text first.
options.better_fit: Use this after recognition when assigning business-field labels.

feedback.intrinsic: The team would try to label values before the photo's words were available as text.
feedback.instructional: Start with OCR, then use field extraction to assign meaning.

options.rationale: OCR output ingestion accepts results already produced by OCR. It cannot create results from a receipt photo.
options.better_fit: Use this when OCR text and metadata are ready for a downstream process.

feedback.intrinsic: No recognized output would yet exist to ingest.
feedback.instructional: Ingestion follows OCR; it does not replace visual-text recognition.

options.rationale: Key-value pairing associates recognized labels with values. It does not turn image pixels into text.
options.better_fit: Use this when recognized labels and nearby values must be associated.

feedback.intrinsic: There would be no reliable recognized labels or values to pair.
feedback.instructional: OCR provides text before downstream association work.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. OCR creates searchable text before values are identified.

payload.prompt: Which can be OCR image inputs? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: A phone photo containing visible text is an OCR input. It enters during image acquisition.
A scan is a common text-containing image input. It enters at the acquisition stage.
A video frame can contain visible text and be supplied as an image. It is an acquisition source.
A confidence score is metadata produced after recognition or extraction. It is not an image for OCR to read.
options.better_fit: Use this when evaluating certainty in a recognized or extracted value.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Photos, scans, and video frames can provide text-containing images.

payload.prompt: Decide whether this statement is true or false.
payload.statement: Input image quality can significantly affect final text-extraction accuracy.
payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Clearer input supports more accurate extraction.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A blurry image can produce inaccurate words.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Image quality at acquisition significantly affects OCR accuracy.

payload.prompt: Arrange the parts to form a correct statement.
payload.explanation: Image acquisition is the entry point for an image containing text.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The entry stage would be confused with later processing.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Begin with image acquisition and state that the image enters OCR there.

payload.prompt: Complete the technical term.

parts.text: A PDF page rendered as an image enters OCR during image

payload.explanation: A rendered PDF page is an image input at the acquisition stage.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The page would be treated as though it had already moved beyond input.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Acquisition accepts the image; preprocessing and detection happen later.

payload.prompt: A shipping workflow receives a scan, a photograph of a label, a PDF page rendered to an image, and a field-definition file. Which items should be supplied to the OCR input stage? Select all that apply.

options.text: The scan of the shipping form
options.rationale: A scan is a text-containing image that OCR can accept as input. It belongs at image acquisition.
Rendering a PDF page produces an image OCR can process. The rendered page is an acquisition input.
A photograph with visible label text is an OCR image input. It enters at acquisition.
A field definition describes desired structured output rather than image content. It is used later to organize values.
options.better_fit: Use this when extracted values must be aligned to a database or API schema.

feedback.intrinsic: OCR would receive no visible text from that file.
feedback.instructional: Image acquisition requires a text-containing image; schemas organize later results.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. The three image sources can enter OCR; the field definition cannot.

payload.prompt: Which OCR stage improves an image before text detection?

options.rationale: Preprocessing optimizes an image before text detection. It can reduce noise, adjust contrast, correct skew, and optimize resolution.
Image acquisition is when an image enters OCR. It does not improve the image.
options.better_fit: Use this when a photograph, scan, frame, or rendered PDF first enters OCR.

options.rationale: Text-region detection locates text-containing areas after preparation. It is not the improvement stage.
options.better_fit: Use this after preparation when locating areas containing text.

options.rationale: Character recognition identifies characters after regions are found. It does not optimize image quality.
options.better_fit: Use this when character shapes are being identified.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Preprocessing improves the image before text areas are found.

payload.prompt: Which tasks are part of preprocessing? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Noise reduction removes artifacts and imperfections from an image. It is a preprocessing task.
Contrast adjustment makes text more distinct from its background. It occurs during preprocessing.
Skew correction aligns rotated text lines. It is an image-preparation activity.
Field mapping assigns recognized values to a schema. It does not improve an input image.
options.better_fit: Use this when a recognized value must be mapped to a labeled field.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. These operations optimize the image before detection.

payload.prompt: Is the following statement accurate?
payload.statement: Preprocessing identifies the areas of an image that contain text.
payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Preprocessing improves the image; text-region detection finds text areas.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: An image can be cleaned or straightened without its text areas being located.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Preprocessing and text-region detection are separate adjacent stages.

payload.prompt: Complete the technical term.

parts.text: Correcting a document's rotation before text detection is called

payload.explanation: Skew correction is a preprocessing operation that fixes document rotation before text detection.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The document's text lines could remain tilted.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Skew correction handles rotation; noise reduction and contrast adjustment address different image defects.

payload.prompt: A healthcare administrator scans a faint, slightly rotated form. Before text regions are found, which action should the system choose?

options.rationale: Preprocessing can adjust contrast for faint text and correct skew for rotation. Both operations occur before text detection.
Acquisition admits an image to OCR but does not fix the stated quality problems. The existing image needs improvement.
options.better_fit: Use this when the task is only to bring a new image source into OCR.

feedback.intrinsic: The same faint, tilted image could enter again unchanged.
feedback.instructional: Use preprocessing to improve contrast and correct skew before detection.

options.rationale: Detection follows preprocessing in the OCR pipeline. Faint text and rotation make preparation appropriate first.
options.better_fit: Use this after image preparation when locating text-containing areas.

feedback.intrinsic: The weak, sloping text could be harder to locate reliably.
feedback.instructional: Improve image quality first, then locate text regions.

options.rationale: Field mapping assigns recognized values to business fields after OCR. It cannot fix input-image quality.
options.better_fit: Use this when recognized names, dates, or amounts need field labels.

feedback.intrinsic: No reliable recognized values would yet exist to map.
feedback.instructional: First prepare, detect, and recognize the image text.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Preprocessing addresses both faintness and rotation before detection.

payload.prompt: Which methods can reduce image noise? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Gaussian filters are a stated method for reducing image noise. They help remove artifacts that interfere with OCR.
Median filters are used for noise reduction. They can reduce visual imperfections in a document image.
Denoising autoencoders are a machine-learning cleanup method. They can reduce image noise before detection.
Hough transforms can support skew correction by detecting line orientation. They are not a listed noise-reduction method.
options.better_fit: Use this when detecting or correcting document rotation.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. These filters and models can reduce image noise.

payload.prompt: Evaluate this statement.
payload.statement: Contrast adjustment makes text more distinct from its background.
payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Contrast adjustment helps characters stand out from their background.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Pale characters could remain hard to distinguish.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Contrast adjustment specifically increases text-background distinction.

payload.prompt: Order the pieces correctly.
payload.explanation: Noise reduction removes artifacts such as dust spots before text detection.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Artifacts could remain when text areas are located.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Put the cleanup action first, followed by what it removes and when.

payload.prompt: Complete the technical term.

parts.text: Making characters stand out from the background is called

payload.explanation: Contrast adjustment increases the difference between text and background.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Characters could remain pale against their background.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Noise reduction addresses artifacts, while skew and resolution address different image problems.

payload.prompt: An accounts-payable specialist scans an invoice with dust spots and pale text. Which actions should be chosen before text detection? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Noise reduction removes dust spots and scanning artifacts. It prepares the invoice for text detection.
Contrast adjustment makes pale text distinct from the background. It improves character visibility before detection.
Document-cleanup CNNs are an image-noise reduction approach. They can remove scanning imperfections.
Row-column association maps table values to field schemas. It does not remove dust or improve text contrast.
options.better_fit: Use this when recognized table values must be associated with schema fields.

feedback.intrinsic: The dust and pale text would remain unchanged.
feedback.instructional: Use cleanup methods for image defects; table association belongs later.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Noise reduction and cleanup CNNs address artifacts, while contrast adjustment addresses pale text.

payload.prompt: What corrects a document so its text lines align horizontally?

options.rationale: Skew correction detects and fixes document rotation. It aligns tilted text lines horizontally.
Noise reduction removes dust, artifacts, and scanning imperfections. It does not correct rotation.
options.better_fit: Use this when artifacts could interfere with text detection.

options.rationale: Contrast adjustment improves text-background distinction. It does not change the angle of text lines.
options.better_fit: Use this when text is faint against its background.

options.rationale: Text-block identification groups characters into spatial units. It does not rotate an image.
options.better_fit: Use this when grouping characters into words, lines, and paragraphs.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Skew correction fixes rotation.

payload.prompt: Which can optimize image resolution for OCR? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Bicubic resampling is a stated resolution-optimization method. It can set an image to a suitable size for OCR.
Bilinear resampling adjusts image resolution. It is another resolution-optimization method.
Super-resolution models intelligently upscale low-resolution text images. They support resolution optimization.
Histogram equalization is a contrast-adjustment technique. It does not directly optimize image resolution.
options.better_fit: Use this when making text more distinct from its background.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Resampling and super-resolution can optimize resolution.

payload.prompt: True or false?
payload.statement: Skew correction removes dust spots and scanning imperfections from a document image.
payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Skew correction fixes rotation; noise reduction removes artifacts.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A page can be straightened while dust spots remain.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Skew correction aligns text lines; noise reduction removes visual artifacts.

payload.prompt: Complete the technical term.

parts.text: Intelligently upscaling a low-resolution text image is called

payload.explanation: Super-resolution models intelligently upscale low-resolution text images.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Low-resolution characters could remain unsuitable for clear recognition.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use super-resolution for intelligent upscaling, not for noise, contrast, or rotation.

payload.prompt: A logistics coordinator receives a phone photo of a shipping form whose text lines slope because the form was photographed at an angle. What should the system apply?

options.rationale: Skew correction detects and corrects image rotation. It makes sloping text lines align horizontally.
Noise reduction removes artifacts such as dust spots. The problem described is page angle, not noise.
options.better_fit: Use this when dust or scanning imperfections obscure text.

feedback.intrinsic: The form's lines would still slope.
feedback.instructional: Use skew correction for rotation; noise reduction addresses artifacts.

options.rationale: Contrast adjustment improves visibility against the background. It cannot align tilted text.
options.better_fit: Use this when characters are faint or low-contrast.

feedback.intrinsic: The text could look clearer but remain tilted.
feedback.instructional: Correct the angle with skew correction.

options.rationale: Layout analysis separates region types such as text and graphics. It does not correct image rotation.
options.better_fit: Use this when separating document regions before character recognition.

feedback.intrinsic: The page could be segmented while its lines still sloped.
feedback.instructional: Layout analysis identifies regions; skew correction fixes angle.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Skew correction aligns the form's text lines.

payload.prompt: What can layout analysis separate in a document image? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Layout analysis distinguishes text regions from other visual areas. This is part of text-region detection.
Layout analysis separates images and graphics from text. This helps reveal document structure.
White space is another region type separated during layout analysis. It helps delimit content areas.
Totals and dates are meaningful values for field extraction. Layout analysis separates visual-region types instead.
options.better_fit: Use this when recognized values must be identified as dates, amounts, or other fields.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Layout analysis separates text, graphics, and white space.

payload.prompt: What does text-block identification group characters into?

options.rationale: Text-block identification uses spatial relationships to organize characters. The resulting structure includes words, lines, and paragraphs.
Dates, names, and amounts are entity types used in extraction. They do not describe spatial text blocks.
options.better_fit: Use this when named entities are being identified from recognized text.

options.rationale: Font and style features may help recognize characters. Text-block identification groups characters into larger layout units.
options.better_fit: Use this when analyzing visual features for character classification.

options.rationale: Fields, schemas, and APIs belong to downstream extraction and integration. They are not groups of characters in a document layout.
options.better_fit: Use this when extracted data is mapped into a target system.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. It organizes characters into readable text structure.

payload.prompt: Decide whether this statement is true or false.
payload.statement: Text region detection finds areas containing text in a preprocessed image.
payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. It locates text areas after preprocessing.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Recognition could start without known text areas.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Text-region detection follows preprocessing and identifies where text appears.

payload.prompt: Reconstruct the statement from the pieces.
payload.explanation: Layout analysis separates text, graphics, and white space to reveal document structure.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Document region types would be confused.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Name layout analysis, then state the region types it separates.

payload.prompt: A legal-document processor must separate a contract's text, signatures or graphics, and blank areas before character recognition. Which approaches fit this layout task? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Connected component analysis is a stated layout-analysis approach. It can help distinguish document regions.
Projection-based segmentation can separate visual regions in a document. It fits the stated layout task.
U-Net is listed as a deep-learning approach for layout analysis. It can identify different visual regions.
A regression CNN can predict a rotation angle for skew correction. It does not separate text, graphics, and blank regions.
options.better_fit: Use this when a document is rotated and text lines must be aligned.

feedback.intrinsic: The contract's regions could remain mixed even after its angle was measured.
feedback.instructional: Use layout-analysis methods to separate regions; rotation models address skew.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. These approaches support layout analysis before character recognition.

flashcards.back: OCR converts visual text into editable, searchable text data.
It is the stage when an image containing text enters OCR.
It fixes document rotation so text lines align horizontally.
It separates text, images, graphics, and white space.
